title: "Corpus"

This page summarizes the current corpus-planning and provenance state for the Sacrificial Debt pilot. Canonical source records live in the project data files after provenance, rights, and checksum review.

## Manual Pilot Scope

The first Sacrificial Debt pilot is Germany-first. Germany is the mechanism-discovery case, while Britain, Australia, and France remain required contrast cases whose matched samples are deferred until the German pilot establishes that the codebook can distinguish sacrificial asymmetry, debt, essentialization, and rival explanations without concept inflation.

The pilot corpus deliberately guards against Koenigsberg-confirmation bias. Hitler-centered evidence is capped as one source family; the pilot also requires Judenzaehlung allegation and contradiction materials, Jewish veteran and organizational sources, Nazi leadership and propaganda comparisons, veterans' memory contexts, and explicit rival/negative-evidence targets.

Canonical planning manifest:

- [`manual-pilot-corpus-v0.1.md`](https://github.com/ashitaka-emishi/fspp-research-wrokbench/blob/master/projects/sacrificial-debt/corpus/manifests/manual-pilot-corpus-v0.1.md)

## Seed Provenance Records

The first seed records are metadata-only source records. They identify bounded
Germany-first source leads, but they do not ingest raw source text, scans, PDFs,
critical apparatus, document records, segments, propositions, or annotations.

Canonical source records:

- [`sources.jsonl`](https://github.com/ashitaka-emishi/fspp-research-wrokbench/blob/master/projects/sacrificial-debt/data/sources.jsonl)

Source records now distinguish:

- corpus tier;
- canonical URL;
- human-readable source location name;
- access datetime;
- capture method;
- checksum scope;
- local path when a working copy exists;
- rights and redistribution status;
- original-language and translation provenance.

Capture methods separate downloaded files, static HTML scrapes,
browser-rendered captures, OCR text, manual transcription, and manual metadata
review. This matters for web pages whose usable text appears only after
JavaScript rendering, and for scans or images that require OCR or transcription.

Rights determine whether captured source material can be committed. Public-domain,
openly licensed, or otherwise redistributable captures may be kept in Git.
Copyrighted, restricted, rights-uncertain, sensitive, or oversized local working
copies remain gitignored and must be listed in the reacquisition log:

- [`GITIGNORED_SOURCES.md`](https://github.com/ashitaka-emishi/fspp-research-wrokbench/blob/master/projects/sacrificial-debt/corpus/provenance/GITIGNORED_SOURCES.md)

Provenance policy:
